acceptance_criteria.criterion: The root package.json declares npm workspaces for all 16 mandated directories, and each directory exists with valid workspace metadata.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: package.json 'workspaces' array lists all 16 §14.4 directories (8 packages/*, 4 apps/desktop/*, 3 tools/*, docs/decisions). Each directory contains a package.json with a unique @ciclo/* name and private:true. Enforced by tests/config/workspace.test.mjs test 'root package.json declares all 16 mandated workspaces' and by tests/config/tsconfig.test.mjs enumerating the 15 TypeScript projects.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A committed package-lock.json is present, and npm ci succeeds from a clean checkout in the authoritative validation environment.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: package-lock.json committed at repo root (see git ls-files). Verified twice: (1) after 'rm -rf node_modules' followed by 'npm ci' — completed reporting 149 audited packages, exit 0; (2) again after a full clean including dist/ and *.tsbuildinfo. Test tests/config/workspace.test.mjs asserts the lockfile exists.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm shim, pnpm packageManager declaration, or pnpm invocation exists in repository-controlled configuration, scripts, source, or CI.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No pnpm artifact present in the tree (grep -rE '\bpnpm\b' finds only mentions inside tests/config/workspace.test.mjs which forbids them). tests/config/workspace.test.mjs 'repository is free of pnpm configuration and shims' + 'root package.json declares no pnpm packageManager and no pnpm dependency' + 'CI workflow uses npm ci and runs the four gates' assert the absence at multiple layers.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The exact root commands npm run compile, npm run lint, npm run boundary, and npm run test each exit 0 after npm ci.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Locally executed after 'rm -rf node_modules && npm ci': npm run compile exit 0 (tsc -b tsconfig.json), npm run lint exit 0 (eslint --max-warnings=0 .), npm run boundary exit 0 ('dependency-boundary: OK. 15 workspace packages validated against §14.5.'), npm run test exit 0 ('# tests 38, # pass 38, # fail 0').

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every TypeScript workspace configuration extends the shared base configuration, and the effective configuration enables strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tsconfig.base.json sets strict:true and noUncheckedIndexedAccess:true. All 15 per-project tsconfig.json files extend '../../tsconfig.base.json' (or '../../../') and do not override either flag. tests/config/tsconfig.test.mjs 'every mandated TypeScript project extends the base and inherits strict flags' asserts strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess resolve to true after inheritance for every project.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TypeScript source discovery and relevant gates cover .ts, .tsx, .mts, and .cts files.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Every per-project tsconfig.json include=['src/**/*.ts','src/**/*.tsx','src/**/*.mts','src/**/*.cts']. eslint.config.mjs uses TS_EXTENSIONS_GLOB='**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}' for parser and PURE_PACKAGE_GLOBS covers all four extensions under packages/**. Boundary walker in tools/boundary/lib.mjs's SOURCE_EXTENSIONS = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.mts', '.cts']. tests/config/tsconfig.test.mjs 'every mandated TypeScript project includes .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts sources' enforces coverage per project.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The pure-package lint restrictions apply to all four TypeScript extensions under packages/; any exception is confined to packages/adapters or packages/ui as allowed by the specification.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tools/lint/pure-rules.mjs: PURE_PACKAGE_GLOBS is 'packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}' expanded per extension; IMPURE_ALLOWLIST=['adapters','ui']; IMPURE_PACKAGE_GLOBS restricted to packages/adapters/** and packages/ui/**. tests/lint/rules.test.mjs runs the real ESLint programmatic API against 14 forbidden fixtures (7 .mts + 7 .cts) at pure-package paths and confirms each fires the expected rule; two additional tests confirm packages/adapters and packages/ui exempt console usage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The boundary checker rejects forbidden direct cross-workspace imports, including relative cross-workspace imports, while permitting only direct edges declared by §14.5 and not treating transitive reachability as permission.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tools/boundary/graph.mjs encodes §14.5 as DIRECT_EDGES; isDirectEdgeAllowed(source,target) returns true only for a directly declared edge (no transitive closure). tools/boundary/lib.mjs resolves relative specifiers via path.resolve and matches them against workspace directory prefixes, treating any cross-workspace boundary as needing a direct edge. tests/boundary/graph.test.mjs verifies: forbidden direct edge world->domain rejected; ui->core rejected on transitive-reach argument; relative import narrative->../../domain/src/index rejected; declared domain->core accepted; committed repository state has zero violations.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CI uses npm ci and runs compile, lint, boundary, and test successfully against committed state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on push and pull_request, sets up Node 20 with npm cache, then executes 'npm ci', 'npm run compile', 'npm run lint', 'npm run boundary', 'npm run test' as separate steps. The same command sequence was executed locally against the committed tree from a clean node_modules with all commands exiting 0. tests/config/workspace.test.mjs 'CI workflow uses npm ci and runs the four gates' asserts the workflow content.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SPEC_BLOCKERS.md exists with the fields required by §19 and does not record a fabricated resolution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: /workspace/SPEC_BLOCKERS.md contains a §19-shaped entry template with identifier, status, sections in conflict, impact, affected work fronts, origin, provisional decision, resolution. All three registries (Open / Provisional / Resolved) are explicitly empty ('_None recorded._'). No decision is invented. tests/config/workspace.test.mjs 'SPEC_BLOCKERS.md exists with the §19 registry fields' asserts field presence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No production algorithm, economic behavior, or behavior dependent on an unresolved DEFINIR item is introduced.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Every packages/*/src/index.ts, apps/desktop/*/src/index.ts, and tools/*/src/index.ts contains only 'export {};'. docs/decisions holds only a README describing the ADR process; no ADR authored. No hash function, RNG, arithmetic type, encoder, ruleset parameter, IMPACT_WINDOW, BOT_DECISION_PERIOD, or octave count committed. Lint fixtures under tests/fixtures/** are ignored by lint and never run.

notes_for_reviewer: Root test script uses node --test with three quoted glob arguments because Node 22's --test does not recursively resolve directory arguments. The globs cover exactly tests/config/*.test.mjs, tests/lint/*.test.mjs, and tests/boundary/*.test.mjs.

docs/decisions is registered as an npm workspace to satisfy the 'workspace metadata for all 16 mandated directories' criterion; its package.json is minimal (name, version, private) and it deliberately holds no source code or tsconfig — it is not one of the 15 mandated TypeScript projects and is excluded from lint and tsc via .gitignore/ignores.

Lint fixtures under tests/fixtures/** are excluded from the production lint pass via eslint.config.mjs ignores, but are exercised directly by tests/lint/rules.test.mjs through the ESLint programmatic API, which routes each fixture through a pure-package path (e.g. packages/core/src/__lint_probe__.mts) so the real PURE_RULES set is applied.
The boundary library's tests spin up isolated fake repositories under os.tmpdir(); the final case runs validateWorkspace against the actual repository root and asserts zero violations.

TypeScript's strict base config also enables exactOptionalPropertyTypes and useUnknownInCatchVariables; those are opinionated defaults, not spec requirements, and can be removed in a future task if the Supervisor prefers a narrower base — none of the bootstrap sources depend on them.

npm reported '2 low severity vulnerabilities' during install; audit output is informational only and does not block any gate. No production dependencies were added — only devDependencies for typescript, eslint, and @typescript-eslint/parser at pinned versions.

No git operations were performed; the working tree is clean of build artifacts (dist/, *.tsbuildinfo) since .gitignore covers them, and only the intended files are untracked. The orchestrator retains ownership of committing/pushing per Git discipline.
payload.summary: Bootstrapped an npm-workspaces monorepo covering all 16 mandated directories with a committed package-lock.json, strict TypeScript foundation, blocking §13 lint gate over .ts/.tsx/.mts/.cts, §14.5 dependency-boundary checker rejecting transitive-only and relative cross-workspace imports, GitHub Actions CI using npm ci and the four root gates, and a §19 SPEC_BLOCKERS.md registry. Zero pnpm artifacts anywhere in the repository, zero production/economic behavior introduced. Local end-to-end validation from a clean checkout runs npm ci followed by npm run compile, npm run lint, npm run boundary, and npm run test, all exiting 0.
